issues.description: Method name mismatch for the farm-song method: the problem statement and UML instruct students to implement a method named `printFarmSong()` (problem_statement.md), but both the template and the reference solution declare and use a method named `singFarmSong()`. This naming inconsistency (printFarmSong vs. singFarmSong) can confuse students who search for or try to implement `printFarmSong()` and may lead them to add a new method that is never used by the provided template/solution or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) update problem_statement.md and the UML to instruct students to implement `singFarmSong()` (and mention `singFarmSongVerse()` if relevant), or (B) rename the method in the template and solution from `singFarmSong()` to `printFarmSong()` (including any calls in Main and tests). Ensure the chosen name is used consistently in the problem text, UML, template stubs, solution, and any tests or sample Main code.
